method: Fraction secants; derivative by exact Lagrange interpolation of m(h) at h = 0; Decimal(60) Taylor series for sin/cos/exp; one-sided classification from exact secants on each side
tolerance: exact strings must match exactly; binary64 secants within 8 * 2^-52 * (|f(x+h)| + |f(x)|)/|h| (rounding of two values, one subtraction, one division); binary64 derivatives within 4 ulps of the 60-digit reference
